verdict: stale. No source found either confirming or overturning 'cancelled' for this specific branch. The 2014 Jiangxi DRC plan (赣发改规划〔2014〕325号) is the last positive documentary trace of the branch's existence, naming it explicitly (赣闽浙支线) with a 743km Jiangxi-internal length and 10 bcm/y capacity for the whole 新粤浙线 project's branch network. A decade of silence since, while the project's Guangxi branch continued into construction/EIA filings, is consistent with GEM's 'cancelled' call but is inference from absence, not a cancellation announcement — the honest read is 'stale': the last real look at this specific branch is over a decade old and nobody has since confirmed either an active build-out or a formal cancellation.
